decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm's core wafer business that fits its stated move toward more complex packaging substrates, it likely benefits from meaningful development investment and enough strategic commitment that management would be reluctant to withdraw it so soon.

Although narrower in scope, the carrier wafer was publicly launched on the website and builds directly on established handling and substrate capabilities, so with no clear evidence of lasting failure management would likely continue it rather than quickly admit a mistaken launch.
